purpose: Design round 2, last part (protocol of configs/adsb_nn_design_v1.json unchanged: October-only readings). Written after the reading that two seeds of base average to 167.74 and blend at -1.12% (recipe proxy -0.50%) against -0.82/-0.94% for the single seeds, so seed averaging dominates every architecture change tried; big (1024x4, dropout 0.2) blends worse (-0.69%); tabm4 is at 167.41 after 12 of 16 epochs at ~3.2x the cost of base. This part measures how the gain scales with more base seeds and the seed noise of tabm4, to choose the architecture per unit of compute.
